title: Influencer & Campaign Marketing
intro: Plan creator and campaign work around a clear idea, a considered audience and well-defined responsibilities.
audience: For brands exploring creator partnerships, campaign concepts or ways to coordinate creative activity across selected channels.
audiencePoints: Teams developing a creator-led campaign brief
Businesses planning a product or brand moment
Marketing teams coordinating partners and creative approvals
deliverables: Clarify the objective, audience, message and role of creator content.
Prepare the key information, content requirements and approval steps.
Align concepts, timelines and brand inputs across the agreed participants.
Summarise delivered materials and available campaign learnings.
process: Agree on the campaign purpose, audience and boundaries.
Prepare the creative idea, creator brief and approval flow.
Support the agreed production and delivery milestones.
Gather available materials and discuss useful next steps.
faqs: Do you guarantee influencer reach or engagement?
No. Audience response depends on the creator, audience, content and platform. Any paid placements and deliverables are agreed before work begins.
The approval owner and timing are agreed in the campaign brief before publishing.
Can a campaign work across several channels?
Yes. The channel plan and any content adaptations should be defined as part of the agreed scope.
